sentences.text: Order Date :- 23.7.2019

Ravi Kant Case :- CRIMINAL REVISION No. - 947 of 2019 Revisionist :-
Raj Kumar Shukla Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Counsel for Revisionist :- Rajeev Kumar Mishra Rudra Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
Criminal Misc. Application No.82896 of 2019.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The present revision has been filed on behalf of the revisionist in Complaint Case No.202 of 2009 (State of U.P. vs. Raj Kumar Shukla), under Sections 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1955, Police Station Kaurhia, District Gonda, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.

entities.text: Complaint Case No.202 of 2009 (State of U.P. vs. Raj Kumar Shukla)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the revisionist submitted that the revisionist is innocent person and has been falsely implicated in the present case and he is having no previous criminal history and already undergone about three weeks and the punishment for the period of two months, he also deposited the fine.
Learned counsel for the revisionist further submitted that the revisionist was on bail during the course of trial as well as during the appeal and he never misuse the liberty of bail.

Learned A.G.A.
has opposed the prayer for bail by submitting that the conduct of the accused-revisionist is not good.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as the sentence awarded to the revisionist, I am of the opinion that the revisionist is entitled to be released on bail.

Let the revisionist-Raj Kumar Shukla convicted and sentenced in the aforesaid case be released on bail on his furnishing personal bonds with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
Order Date :- 23.7.2019
